notes.text: One handwritten continuation paragraph, with no displayed equation, diagram, drawing, letter heading, date, salutation or signature. No author page number is legible. H’s page{5} was treated as witness page metadata, not imported as author ink. Archive pencil foliation is 63.

The author describes sigma using the symmetry of L tensor L, interpreted as a section of left-subscript-2 N. The words champs, s’obtient en and L are physically interlinear insertions. This is an account of the author’s claim; no construction was independently proved.

notes.location: Je sais prouver through qu’elle est nulle
notes.text: The author explicitly writes Je sais prouver (sauf erreur), then claims every hom. M to left-subscript-2 N comes from a suitable Picard champ. The stated obstruction is in Ext cubed (X; M,N); an argument qualified by the uncertain quoted adjective universel/universal is said to make it vanish. No proof is supplied here or checked by this reader.

The author says the extension (*) is close to splitting because a section of the third sheaf over any object lifts, expressed as a set-theoretic section. Remonte is read from its final te and medial strokes, not from an expected formulation.

The final claim associates a section over U in Ob X to an element of script H squared with the written E/underlined-F-prime expression. The two H forms were each inspected. The detached lower bar and the argument separators remain physical glyph doubts; no mathematical repair or delimiter normalization was made.

Two small points were considered as possible punctuation against possible copying flecks. Their intentional status remains uncertain in the text and report. The adjacent heavy vertical trace is not treated as an omitted word or a drawing.

All mathematical work in this reading was identification of written symbols and statements. No proof, counterexample, algebraic derivation, or independent verification was performed; the checks array is empty.

coverage: The whole page was viewed once for layout, then supplied half a and half b once each in order. Every physical text line was compared word by word with both complete witnesses, including all agreed words, accents, small words, punctuation, superscripts, left subscripts, the arrow and its head, the tensor sign, all quoted words, and the final nested expression. The single prose paragraph, both marginal horizontal strokes, every actual insertion and cancellation, and archive foliation were covered. All residual C doubts and unresolved witness differences were taken to one tight crop for the relevant locus; adjacent unresolved symbols in the final formula share one formula crop, and the two H occurrences were inspected separately in different crops. There are no displays, diagrams or author drawings. H expands tte, supplies punctuation and an extra deleted placeholder not supported at their stated places, and uses blackboard H where both written forms are looped script H. C does not represent the small point below M in the final formula; neither witness represents the possible point after that formula. Both point readings remain explicitly uncertain because copying artefacts are possible. Non-text edge traces are recorded as a comment, not converted to text or a diagram. No OCR, external source, other page or other reader was consulted. No LaTeX compilation or mathematical proof verification was performed.
